title: Monitored Anesthesia Care and Soft Tissue Infiltration With Local Anesthesia Feasibility Trial
official: Monitored Anesthesia Care and Soft Tissue Infiltration With Local Anesthesia for Older Adults With Hip Fracture: A Multi-Center Feasibility Randomized Clinical Trial
summary: The purpose of this study is to establish preliminary efficacy of Monitored Anesthesia Care and Soft Tissue Infiltration with Local Anesthesia (MAC-STILA) on severity of post operative delirium and secondary outcomes in patients with and without cognitive impairment.

interventions.name: Soft Tissue Infiltration with Local Anesthetic (STILA)
